Name: Rainbow of Hens for Adopt N Skin
Author: jayjaydub
Description:
Hi Friends!

This is a mod of spritesheets of different colored chickens for Adopt N Skin. 

To use, drag the tilesheets you wish to use to one or both of these locations, depending on what you want to replace. 

AdoptSkin>Assets>Skins>BrownChicken
AdoptSkin>Assets>Skins>WhiteChicken 

Is there a color you want that's missing? Let me know! I'm reachable here and on discord username Jessie#4755

All of the thanks to Gathouria for both making Adopt N Skin and making it so easy to use.
Also thanks to the Krobus Crew for the support on this :D
